name: Inspect SSD updater
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca 'cd /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; ls -l *ua-update* scripts/ua-update 2>/dev/null || true; for f in *ua-update* scripts/ua-update; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f"; sed -n "1,180p" "$f"; }; done'
description: Inspect Clementine’s existing update helper before using it.
